Richard F. Burton, Vikram and the Vampire.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/richard-f-burton/vikram-and-the-vampire

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Richard F. Burton, the author, died 1890 (Wikidata Q125057; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Francis_Burton).

First publication of the text used: 1870 (SE colophon: 'Vikram and the Vampire was published in 1870 by Richard F. Burton.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1870, before 1931. Works published before 1931 are in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: not needed. Every person named above died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
